# Environment variables

The variables that go-common packages declare in the `env` registry, with what they default to and what they do. Each package still parses its own values; the registry lists them, checks the ones that are set when a service starts (a value that does not parse, a variable that was removed, a likely typo of a declared name) and shows them, redacted, on the debug server's `/debug/config`. To document a variable, declare it with `env.Declare` in its package; CI fails if this file is stale.

## `graph`

| Variable | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FLEET_NODE` | string | unset | Logical name of the host (VM) this process runs on, sent as the X-Fleet-Node header: a lower-case DNS label. Anything else is ignored with one log line. |
| `GRAPH_API_KEY` | string | (secret) | Writer-only API key, the compatibility path for services not yet using GRAPH_API_KEY_FILE. Never falls back to FLEET_API_KEY. |
| `GRAPH_API_KEY_FILE` | string | unset | Path of the protected file holding the writer API key. It takes precedence over GRAPH_API_KEY, and an unreadable file fails closed. |
| `GRAPH_BUFFER_SIZE` | int | `10000` | Events buffered before the oldest are dropped; at least 64. |
| `GRAPH_COLLECTOR_URL` | string | unset | URL of the fleet-graph collector: the canonical https host or a loopback address. |
| `GRAPH_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | Opt-in switch for emitting service-to-service call events. Emission also needs GRAPH_COLLECTOR_URL and a writer key. |
| `GRAPH_FLUSH_BATCH` | int | `500` | Events per flush request; at least 1. |
| `GRAPH_FLUSH_INTERVAL` | int | `10` | Seconds between flushes of buffered events (an integer number of seconds, not a duration); at least 1. |
| `GRAPH_READER_API_KEY` | string | (secret) | Read-side key for graph lookups, kept separate from the writer key. |
| `GRAPH_SAMPLE_RATE` | float | `1` | Fraction of events kept, clamped to the range 0 to 1. |
| `GRAPH_SERVICE_ID` | string | unset | Canonical registry id used as the identity of batches and events: a lower-case DNS label. An invalid value fails closed. |
| `GRAPH_TARGET_ALIASES` | list | unset | Comma-separated host=canonical-service-id pairs that map an outbound host to a service id. |
| `GRAPH_TRUSTED_CALLER_IPS` | list | unset | Comma-separated literal IP addresses of gateways trusted to stamp X-Auth-User. Entries that are not literal IPs are ignored. |

## `runtimetune`

| Variable | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FLEET_RUNTIME_GOGC_BASE` | int | `100` | GOGC used once the live heap is at or above the minimum heap target; positive. |
| `FLEET_RUNTIME_GOGC_MAX` | int | `800` | Upper bound on the GOGC the floor logic may set; positive. |
| `FLEET_RUNTIME_MEMLIMIT_RATIO` | float | `0.8` | Fraction of the cgroup memory limit used as GOMEMLIMIT, strictly between 0 and 1. |
| `FLEET_RUNTIME_MIN_HEAP_BYTES` | int | `33554432` | Minimum heap target in bytes that the GOGC floor aims for; 0 disables the floor and leaves GOGC untouched. |
| `FLEET_RUNTIME_TUNING` | string | `enabled` | Set to a falsey value to disable all runtime tuning. Anything unrecognised also disables it, so a typo here turns tuning off. |
| `FLEET_RUNTIME_TUNING_INTERVAL` | duration | `30s` | How often the GOGC floor is recomputed; a positive duration such as 5s. |

## `server`

| Variable | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `LOG_FORMAT` | string | `text` | Set to json to switch the process to structured JSON logs (package logx): the access log and everything written through the standard log package gain the service, version and node, and the trace id inside a traced request, and credentials are redacted. text, the default, leaves the output as it was. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | string | `info` | Minimum level when LOG_FORMAT=json: debug, info, warn or error. |
